title: Check before you pay
lede: About to send money to someone new? Enter who you're paying and we'll check them against reported fraud and the details they gave you.

idleCard.title: What this check does
items: Report history for this number or account
Whether the number, account or IBAN is correctly formatted
Guidance based on the purpose and amount you enter
idleCard.note: We never move money or contact the person you're paying.

idleBody: Choose how you're paying and enter their number, account or IBAN, then check.
missingIdentifier: Enter a phone number, account number or IBAN first.

verdictBody.stop: At least one check on this identifier failed outright. Don't send money until you've confirmed it another way.
verdictBody.caution: Nothing rules this out, but something here is worth a second look before you send money.
verdictBody.clear: Nothing in our report history or format checks stands out. That is not the same as a guarantee.

findings.REPORTED: Reported {count} time(s) by other FraudLens users.
findings.NOT_REPORTED: Not reported by any FraudLens user so far.
findings.IBAN_FORMAT_INVALID: This doesn't look like a valid IBAN.
findings.IBAN_CHECKSUM_FAILED: This IBAN's check digits don't add up — it may be mistyped.
findings.IBAN_LENGTH_WRONG: This is the wrong length for a {country} IBAN.
findings.IBAN_FOREIGN: This is a {country} IBAN, not a Mauritian one.
findings.PHONE_VALID: Looks like a valid Mauritian mobile number.
findings.PHONE_NOT_MU_MOBILE: This doesn't look like a Mauritian mobile number.
findings.ACCOUNT_FORMAT_ODD: This account number's format looks unusual.
findings.ORGANISATION_ON_PERSONAL_NUMBER: You named {organisation}, but this is a personal phone number, not a business account.
findings.LARGE_AMOUNT: Rs {amount} is a large amount to send this way — transfers like this are hard to reverse.

caveat: FraudLens can't confirm who owns this number, account or IBAN — only report history and whether it's correctly formatted. Always verify identity through a channel you already trust.

whatToDo.clear: Verify the person independently before you send.

whatToDoBody.stop: Contact the person or organisation on a number or address you already had — not one they just gave you — before sending anything.
whatToDoBody.caution: Confirm who you're paying through a channel you already trust, then send only what you agreed.
whatToDoBody.clear: A clean check isn't proof of identity. Confirm who you're paying through a channel you already trust.
